visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a light blue puffer jacket and a beige scarf, stands in a brightly lit beauty store. She holds a pink box of hair masks while smiling and looking at the camera. The background is filled with neatly arranged retail shelves of cosmetic products. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of the store interior, showing a crowded aisle labeled 'Trending Now'. Shoppers, mostly female, are seen from behind browsing the shelves. The lighting is bright and industrial-modern. (3) A close-up shot features a silver cylindrical skincare bottle held by a hand with polished nails. A 'TRY ME' sticker is visible on the bottle. The background is a blur of store shoppers and shelving. (4) The woman holds up a pink setting spray bottle in front of store shelves. She makes an expressive facial gesture, indicating a recommendation. (5) A close-up of a pink hair mask box is shown, followed by the woman holding it and pointing at the packaging details. (6) In a different section of the store, the woman holds a yellow tin of health supplements next to a large basket filled with similar products. A sign above says 'NOW ON!'. (7) The scene moves to a makeup display where the woman holds an eye makeup pencil. She points to a promotional poster featuring a model. (8) A close-up shows the woman's hand as she swatches two shades of the makeup pencil on her skin. (9) She demonstrates a makeup tool with a small white brush tip. (10) The woman holds a yellow container featuring a cartoon lion character and smiles towards the camera, wrapping up the presentation.
